strategies.title: Dabarar hanya
strategies.description: Zabi dabarar hanya. A Yanayin Manual zaka ja don saita tsari; da sauran dabarun hanya ta live ci a kan dogara, gudun da hankali.
strategies.guardrailsTooltip: Koyaushe-kan gadi: babban ɗakin da aka keɓe kyauta × hukumci mai iyaka-rayuwa. A ƙasa 1.0 yana nufin ana riƙe samfurin baya.
strategies.scoreTooltip: Makin tuƙi na ƙarshe = matsakaicin ma'auni na gatari uku, wanda aka ninka ta hanyoyin tsaro. Manyan hanyoyin farko.
strategies.modeManualHint: Yanayin da hannu: buƙatun suna bin tsari na ƙasa, sama-zuwa ƙasa. Ja don sake yin oda.
strategies.modeScoreHint: Sabunta maki daga zirga-zirga kai tsaye. Tsarin da ke ƙasa shine yadda ake bi da buƙatun a yanzu.
strategies.manualBlurb: Hanya a daidai tsari da kuka saita a ƙasa. Jawo hannaye don sake yin oda. Babu ci; ana bin sarkar sama zuwa kasa.
strategies.balancedBlurb: Dogara yana kaiwa (50%), tare da nauyi da hankali daidai gwargwado (25% kowanne). Tsohuwar ma'ana mai ma'ana.
strategies.smartestBlurb: Zaɓi mafi kyawun samfurin da har yanzu yake aiki. Hankali 55%, AMINCI 35%, saurin 10%.
strategies.fastestBlurb: Zaɓi samfurin mafi sauri wanda har yanzu yana aiki. Gudun 55%, aminci 35%, hankali 10%.
strategies.reliableBlurb: Yawaita ƙimar nasara sama da duka. Amintaccen 70%, sauri da hankali 15% kowanne.
strategies.customBlurb: Saita ma'auni na abin dogaro, saurin gudu da hankali tare da faifai. Inji iri ɗaya da waɗanda aka saita, kawai ma'aunin ku.
strategies.customWeightsHelp: Sliders masu zaman kansu ne; hannun jari auto-balance zuwa 100%.
strategies.weightRequired: Aƙalla nauyi ɗaya dole ne ya kasance sama da sifili.

premium.title: Premium
premium.description: Katalojin samfurin rayuwa, akan kowace na'ura.
premium.liveDescription: Sabbin samfura na kyauta, sauye-sauyen ƙididdiga, da gyare-gyaren quirk sun sauka anan cikin sa'o'i da jigilar kaya. Aikace-aikacen yana duba ta atomatik sau biyu a rana; babu abin yi.
premium.snapshotDescription: Matakin kyauta: kundin yana wartsakewa daga hoton kowane wata, ana dubawa ta atomatik sau biyu a rana. Premium yana canza wannan zuwa ciyarwar kai tsaye, ana sabuntawa kowane kwanaki 2-3.
premium.willNotRenew: Ba zai sabunta ba. Premium har zuwa {date}, to wannan shigarwar zata koma cikin kundin kyauta na kowane wata.
premium.keyInactive: Wannan maɓalli baya aiki. App ɗin yana ci gaba da aiki akan kasida ta wata-wata kyauta.
premium.manageHint: Sarrafa biyan kuɗi yana buɗe tashar caji ta Stripe: soke, sabunta katin ku, ko zazzage daftari. Cire maɓallin yana kashe wannan na'urar ne kawai; siyanka ba'a taba.
premium.keyHint: Makullin ku yana cikin imel ɗin siyan ku da kuma akan shafin bayan-bincike. Bata shi?
premium.recoverKey: Mai da shi a kan gidan yanar gizon
premium.upsellDescription: Sabbin samfuran kyauta a lokacin da suke wanzuwa, maimakon kwanaki 30 daga baya. Maɓalli ɗaya, kowace na'ura. Soke kowane lokaci; na'ura mai ba da hanya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa zauna free har abada.
